content: Write a poetic tribute to a loved one.

In you, I found a friend so rare,
With a heart overflowing with love and care,
Your presence brought light to my darkest nights,
And made everything so bright.

In my life, you're an irreplaceable treasure,
A pure and honest soul beyond measure,
With your smile, you melt away my pains,
And in your embrace, all my fears are drained.

You gave me strength when I was weak,
And held me up when I couldn't speak,
Your unwavering love and support,
Has been my constant lifeline and resort.

I wish I could dedicate the stars above,
To you, my dear, who fills my life with love,
But for now, all I can do is say,
That you'll always be the sunshine of my day.

So, here's to you, my beloved one,
May your light always shine brighter than the sun,
And may your heart be forever filled with love,
As you soar high on the wings of a dove.
